newsitem.title: USA: Bergsten won't comment on Clinton job report.
newsitem.headline: Bergsten won't comment on Clinton job report.

text.p: Influential private economist Fred Bergsten declined comment Friday on a recent newspaper report that he was being considered for a top job in the second Clinton administration.
"I don't have any comment," he told reporters before a luncheon sponsored by the Institute for International Economics think-tank which he heads.

The Journal of Commerce newspaper reported Thursday that Bergsten was being considered as a replacement for Laura Tyson as head of Clinton's National Economic Council. Tyson has said she intends to return to California.
